text:
I had very good experience with this doctor. First time in years I was prescribed with medication with consideration of side effects, that I had experienced from some drugs.

When I first contacted doctor assistant I got price little higher that it was stated on the website, but as it turned out this price included not only consultation, but prescribed drugs itself that I got right in doctor's office.

Very highly recommend!

text:
Got recommend from the other clinic due to some stress issue. Very disappointment.
Need to improve quality of service and the way to approach the patients.
Better go somewhere else.

restaurant_name: คลินิก หมอณัฐนัยนา
text:
Dr. Natnaiyana is an excellent psychiatrist, she helped my wife in a very difficult situation associated with a depressive state.

The first time we came without an appointment, we received a detailed consultation and all the necessary preparations. The doctor is very attentive to the patient's medical history and is clearly aware of the latest trends in pharmacology and Western psychiatry. She has a large selection of original drugs and generics, including very new ones.

Plus, you will not overpay for imposed services and overpriced medicines, as in many large hospitals.

Definitely recommend!

restaurant_name: คลินิก หมอณัฐนัยนา
text:
Messaged the clinic regarding a requirement for prescription medication on numerous occasions.
Only had to send my UK doctor's note once, they kept everything on file, for future requirements. They treated me with patience, respect & understanding, even when paying money to their thai bank account from my UK one was proving difficult!
Very kind, very effictient.
Recommend

text: Very disappointed in the service, doesn’t care about patients, only cares about money to be made from medication. Would not recommend for anyone.

I took my son for treatment. I talked to the doctor for 20 minutes, maybe even less.
The cost of medication and treatment was exorbitant.
Compared to a 20-minute consultation with the doctor, it was very expensive.

text: The doctor was polite, but his explanation wasn't in-depth. The medication is quite expensive. This disease is really not suitable for poor people.

text:
I took my mother to the doctor.

- The assistant quoted 500-1000 baht, but charged 1,200 baht, not including medication. This is quite expensive for a consultation that lasted less than half an hour.
- Parking is on the street.
- The clinic needs improvement, especially the step leading into the clinic which caused someone to trip and fall. The mat isn't non-slip either.
